items.reason: Whole-set routing prints the set identifier, resolved Runtime path, and binding kind before execution renders the status table.
Header rendering is unconditional after successful routing, including inside the bound checkout.
The comparison uses checkout roots rather than the invocation directory, omitting “invoked from” when invoked from a checkout subdirectory.
BoundDefault triggers the “binding recorded to current checkout” announcement.
The old conditional “draining at bound checkout” output is removed.
AFK file runs print the current-checkout path without a Drain header.
HITL file runs return through runTargetedHITLGate before reaching the new current-checkout line.
Whole-set completion prints one green “✓ <set>/<task> done” result.
Commit SHA or verified no-op detail prints immediately beneath the completion result.
The old task completion printer is removed, with one result emitted per ending.
Exhausted retries retain the failed transition and emit one red failed result.
Provider exhaustion retains the open state and emits the distinct red “out of agents (left open)” result.
Quota parking emits a yellow quota-paused result naming the verdict’s preset.
Interrupted execution errors emit the yellow interrupted result.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reporting paths without Task result lines; executed tasks retain their results.
Attempt failure narration and exhausted-walk reporting remain; successful attempt breakdowns move beneath the completion detail.
Both renderers use outputFor, preserving complete plain-text output for redirected streams.
Result lines use semantic colors through the existing TTY and NO_COLOR handling.
The added reporting performs no journal writes or new state transitions.

scores.rationale: Clear shared renderers and useful tests, but coverage misses the directory and HITL defects; single-task quota pauses also incorrectly reach printTaskDone.
